description: Canonical, cross-repo C++ tokenizer contract. Single source of truth for vocab size and special-token ids shared by cppmega (CUDA/Megatron), cppmega_mlx (MLX), and nanochat (data pipeline). The shipped tokenizer.json is FROZEN at 65536; new logical roles are mapped onto pre-existing <RESERVED_N> slots (id == N) rather than adding tokens, so no retrain is required.
tokenizer_artifact_sha_note: validated against cppmega_mlx/tokenizer/tokenizer.json: model vocab == 65536, max id == 65535, added_tokens ids 0..7199 (incl. 4896 <RESERVED_N> slots).

reserved_role_assignments._doc: Logical roles bound to existing <RESERVED_N> slots (token content '<RESERVED_N>' has id N). Reuse, do not add. Verifier checks each id resolves to its <RESERVED_N> token. Domain-delimiter roles use START/END opener-closer pairs for wrapped source, build metadata, diagnostics, tests, and tool output.

vocab_dual_track_note._doc: Two intentional vocab profiles exist (config/model.py VocabMetadata). The FIRST from-scratch foundation run uses the 65536 local profile (this contract), matching the shipped tokenizer. The 131072 megacpp profile is a separate, larger future tokenizer and MUST NOT be paired with the 65536 artifact.
